shared_elements: upright rectangular slab with a bordered decorated field
vertical framing bands of repeated ornament along the edges
a central dominant motif filling the panel
justification: Both are upright slabs with a framed central field flanked by vertical decorative borders, and both use small curling/rosette-like ornaments, but this is a generic layout convention. A depicts a large naturalistic winged anthropomorphic figure in profile with a beard, headdress, staff and small attendant figure, while B depicts no figures at all, only abstract interlaced knotwork, a central disc of interlocking spirals, and serpentine scrollwork.
